table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	fullcode=service.aliasname,
	itemname= service.name, 
	servicedetail.servicecode,
	itemcode = servicedetail.servicecode,
	currlistrow = 0,
	servicedetail.serviceinvcode,   
	Servicedetail.smancode,
	Servicedetail.qty,
	servicedetail.price,
	PreDiscPerc=ROUND( (servicedetail.serviceflatdisc / CASE WHEN servicedetail.Price > 0 THEN servicedetail.Price ELSE 1 END) * 100, 2),
	servicedetail.serviceflatdisc,
	allowsaleindecimal=service.allowsaleindecimal,
	Servicedetail.Commission,
	Servicedetail.CostPrice,
	SrvORowId = 1,
	ServiceStatus = 'N',
	LockPrice = Service.LockPrice,
	LockDiscPerc = Service.LockDiscPerc,
	LockServiceFlatDisc = Service.LockServiceFlatDisc,
	servicedetail.DeliveryDate,
	servicedetail.SampleTaken,
	servicedetail.ReportMade,
	servicedetail.Remarks,
	servicedetail.serviceflattax,
	servicedetail.servicegstperc,
	servicedetail.shareperc,
	Servicedetail.discperc
FROM 
	servicedetail, service 
WHERE 
	( servicedetail.serviceinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode )    AND
	( servicedetail.servicecode = service.servicecode )

objects.name: c_detaildwtotal
objects.expression: sum (( saleprice - serviceflatdisc) * qty * (1-  (discperc * 0.01)) for all )
